system.description:
The Toreador may cloak her words so that her target hears one message — the intended one — while everyone else nearby hears an entirely different, innocuous message, with no sense that anything is amiss. This power is invaluable for disciplining or praising underlings in front of others, disguising diplomatic insults as flattery, or letting Courts of Love lovers speak plainly under cover of courtly nonsense.

System: The power lasts one turn per point of Willpower spent. To determine how well the hidden message was conveyed, the player rolls Manipulation + Empathy (difficulty of 10 minus the listener's Perception).
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans
